say:2:1620772002:1.text: I've noticed the flying Hypofiends summoned from chaos magic are quite tame... They just need guidance. I'll study harder and figure out a way to control them.

narration:3:1620772003:1.text: Over the course of the night, you deal with countless transformed monsters, all sorts of bizarre flying creatures, and explosions big and small... Fortunately, the students emerge completely unharmed.
